scope: Production web/PWA. Native builds are not present in this repository.

areas: staff activity, missing items and high-value alerts

architecture.cache: One RTK Query cache; durable namespace is account + tenant/store + role + sorted permissions. RTK serializes endpoint + all record/filter/search/page/sort/date arguments. Session epoch prevents old responses crossing scopes.
architecture.navigation: No time expiry or mount-driven refetch. Adjacent-page prefetch only fills missing entries.
architecture.updates: Existing socket events plus generic tenant change events; Mongo-backed revision checks every 60 seconds while visible, focus/reconnect checks, and 5-minute reconciliation fallback. Stored results stay visible throughout.
architecture.persistence: IndexedDB v2: snapshots, drafts, identity and outbox. Snapshot schema v1 ignores incompatible data. Tokens/headers and mutation payload caches are not persisted as snapshots.
architecture.shell: Build-generated versioned service worker precaches all route chunks, CSS and app icons. Public same-origin uploads and public ImageKit images cache after successful readable download. New worker waits for old tabs; no API/token/proof service-worker cache.

actions: edit cart using saved product details
edit persisted page choices and drafts
packing item pick/pack/missing, ordered per order with stable UUIDs, original recording time, current assignment/status validation and transactional server receipts
server sign-out revocation after local sign-out
checkout acceptance and POS bill acceptance

confirmationIntents: POS, checkout, bill collections and supplier payment retries preserve their original payload/request ID durably before sending. Financial intents require explicit confirmation in their original form; they are never automatically booked on reconnect. Packing alone replays automatically after current authentication.
limitations: Only downloaded exact query variants are available offline; an unvisited filter/page/report range must be downloaded online.
Guest order tracking uses a tab-scoped access secret and is intentionally excluded from durable public snapshots. Signed-in customer tracking is persisted.
Unseen images, private payment proof files, unsupported remote image hosts and external Google font downloads are not guaranteed offline; system font fallback remains available.
Financial/privileged/delivery workflow confirmations remain online-only; pending local work is not included in confirmed totals.
View/draft restoration covers explicit useSavedViewState fields and cart storage; modal visibility, microphones, files and arbitrary transient form state are not persisted.

Offline authorization cannot discover remote revocation until reconnect; offline authorization expires 12 hours after the last actual identity confirmation and explicit 401/403 responses discard the active scope.
Direct maintenance/database changes reconcile within the 5-minute fallback; ordinary API writes publish shared revisions and realtime events.
